svg.text: Stereo Model with Thin Inclined Parallel Plate

text.tspan: For parallel faces and the same exterior medium,
the emergent ray is parallel to the incident ray.
The plate makes the pixel → 3D line mapping effectively

svg.text: The effective stereo baseline becomes ray-dependent in the plate model.
A thin inclined plane-parallel plate preserves the exterior ray direction but introduces a lateral shift.
In StereoComplex notation, this appears as a pixel-dependent effective origin for each channel.
